tasks.title: Prehistoric cave art
paras: Prehistoric cave art is a form of art that was created thousands of years ago. Prehistoric cave art offers a glimpse into the lives of early humans and the way they lived. Found in caves across Europe, Asia, and Africa, these artworks depict animals, human figures, and abstract symbols. The Lascaux Cave in France and the Altamira Cave in Spain are among the most famous sites.

Researchers believe cave art served various purposes. Some theories suggest the paintings were part of hunting rituals. Others propose the art taught younger generations about animals. Additionally, some argue the artworks had religious significance.

The techniques used to create cave art were advanced for the time. Early humans employed tools made from bone, stone, and wood to carve images into the rock. They used natural pigments like ochre and charcoal to paint scenes. The placement of the art in hard - to - reach areas suggests creating these images was a deliberate act. Despite the mystery surrounding their exact purpose, cave art remains a vital link to understanding human history and cultural development.

questions.stem: The word “depict” in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：词汇题 原文定位：these artworks depict animals, human figures, and abstract symbols. 解析：depict 意为描绘、展示、刻画。 选项分析： A. hide 隐藏 —— 语义相反 B. show 展示、描绘 —— 同义匹配，正确 C. combine 结合 —— 无关 D. move 移动 —— 不符语境

questions.stem: What is suggested about the Lascaux and Altamira caves?

options.A: They are the only sites where cave art is found.
options.B: They contain some of the most famous cave art.
options.C: Their paintings were created for educational purposes.
options.D: Their artworks represent deities or ancestral spirits.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：The Lascaux Cave in France and the Altamira Cave in Spain are among the most famous sites. 解析：这两处洞穴属于最著名的史前洞穴艺术遗址之一。 选项分析： A. 仅有的洞穴艺术遗址 ——only 绝对化，原文还有欧、亚、非多地，错误 B. 拥有一些最著名的洞穴艺术 —— 完全对应原文，正确 C. 画作只为教育目的 —— 只是其中一种理论，不是专属用途，错误 D. 描绘神灵或祖先灵魂 —— 文中未提及，无中生有

questions.stem: All of the following are true about prehistoric cave art EXCEPT:

options.A: It depicts animals, human figures, and abstract symbols.
options.B: It served various purposes, including hunting rituals.
options.C: It was created using natural pigments.
options.D: It is found mostly in Europe.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：细节排除题 原文定位：Found in caves across Europe, Asia, and Africa 解析：洞穴艺术分布在欧、亚、非三大洲，并非主要集中在欧洲。 选项分析： A. 描绘动物、人物、抽象符号 —— 第一段原句，排除 B. 有狩猎仪式等多种用途 —— 第二段原文，排除 C. 使用天然颜料创作 —— 第三段有提及，排除 D. 主要分布在欧洲 —— 与跨三大洲表述矛盾，正确

questions.stem: What is the relationship between paragraphs 2 and 3?

options.A: Paragraph 3 provides examples of animals mentioned in paragraph 2.
options.B: Paragraph 3 challenges the theories mentioned in paragraph 2.
options.C: Paragraph 3 discusses what was used to create cave art while paragraph 2 discusses the purpose for its creation.
options.D: Paragraph 3 discusses a different kind of prehistoric art very similar to prehistoric cave art discussed in paragraph 2.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：段落关系题 解析：第 2 段：讲洞穴艺术创作的各种目的 / 用途第 3 段：讲创作使用的工具、颜料、技法 选项分析： A. 第三段举例第二段动物 —— 无相关内容，错误 B. 第三段反驳第二段理论 —— 无反驳，错误 C. 第三段讲创作材料技法，第二段讲创作目的 —— 逻辑对应，正确 D. 第三段讲另一种类似史前艺术 —— 仍是同一种洞穴艺术，话题没变，错误

questions.stem: Why does the author mention hard - to - reach areas in the caves?

options.A: To suggest that the cave art was created by highly skilled individuals
options.B: To indicate that cave art was an intentional and meaningful act
options.C: To propose that the artwork represented deities
options.D: To explain the difficulty in finding these artworks

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：The placement of the art in hard-to-reach areas suggests creating these images was a deliberate act. 解析：画作被画在很难抵达的偏僻位置，说明古人不是随手涂鸦，而是刻意、有意义的行为。 选项分析： A. 暗示创作者技艺极高 —— 原文没强调绘画技巧，只强调位置刻意，错误 B. 表明洞穴艺术是有意且有特殊意义的行为 —— 对应 deliberate act，正确 C. 说明画作代表神灵 —— 文中无相关内容，无中生有 D. 解释这些艺术品很难被发现 —— 作者重点在创作初衷，不是后人寻找难度，错误
